t: The Team page lists everyone in your workspace. Everyone can see it; admins can change it.
In this video, you will learn how to find people, see who is online and where, change your own photo and password, and, as an admin, add and manage people.
To open this page, click Team in the left menu.
The numbers show people and seats, who is online now, admins, and storage.
The list shows each person's email, role, status, and location: in the office or remote.
On the right are your plan's seats and storage.
Use Search people, Filters and Columns to find who you need.
Select a person and press Profile to see their details and where they are working from.
My photo changes your picture. My password changes your password.
Admins press Add person, type the name and work email, and send an invite or a temporary password.
Edit changes someone's details or password. Deactivate stops them signing in, and frees their seat.
Office address tells ShankhNaad your office's internet address, so it knows who is in the office.
Next in the People menu: Organization chart.
